Check that the required tools are available

Source: R/setup.R
check_punkst_setup.Rd

Looks for the punkst binary and a Python interpreter with spatialdata and reports what was found. It runs each tool once (punkst --help and a short python -c import) but never installs or builds anything. If the binary is missing, the message points to the build recipe.

Usage

check_punkst_setup(bin = NULL, python = NULL, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

bin, python

Optional overrides; see punkst_setup().

quiet

If FALSE, print a summary.

Value

A punkstConfig object with properties bin, python, bin_ok, python_ok, spatialdata_version, zarr_version, notes.

Examples

cfg <- check_punkst_setup(quiet = TRUE)
cfg
#> punkst binary : OK      /home/runner/work/punkstR/punkstR/punkst-0.1.2-linux-x86_64-glibc2.28/bin/punkst 
#> python/sdata  : OK      /opt/punkst-venv/bin/python-preload (spatialdata 0.8.0, zarr 3.4.2)
